recognition.why_valuable: The Human Director has articulated the semantic contract of the Smart Note, Intelligent Block, and Smart Link, and identified the single hardest unresolved rule in the system: that 'Smart Note this' means DISTILL, not STORE. That rule currently exists only as prose. Until it is machine-enforced at the receiver, a future agent can satisfy the letter of the contract by persisting a raw transcript and still be wrong. This proposal carries the distilled definition plus the missing enforcement requirement so the rule can be ratified and bound to the receiver.
recognition.proposed_future_use: Bind 'DISTILL, not STORE' as an enforced precondition at the canonical Smart Note receiver, and use the perspective set (Human / AI / Simple / Language / Machine / Evidence / Provenance / Governance) as the required shape of every projected Smart Note. Also apply the same distillation discipline to NayaNET-facing output so the Super Brain does not accumulate bloat.

source_refs: Human Director conversation, 2026-09-26, Smart Note / Intelligent Block / Smart Link definition and ultimate-system design request

candidate.title: Smart Note means DISTILL, not STORE; the Smart Link is the completion proof
candidate.lesson: A Smart Note is a distilled, multi-perspective Intelligent Block, not a transcript. A Smart Link is the evidence-bearing hyperlink returned only after the intelligence is actually committed and projected, so 'no verified Smart Link' means 'no completed user-facing operation'. Unenforced, this becomes a bloat engine: the Super Brain accumulates raw output, retrieval degrades, and nobody reads the notes.
candidate.content: Distilled definition: Smart Note = distilled intelligence made reusable. Intelligent Block = the governed canonical object containing that intelligence with its perspectives, provenance, relationships, and evidence; a unit of cognition that survives its original conversation. Smart Link = the clickable, independently inspectable proof returned in-conversation after commit and projection, converting 'claim -> trust' into 'claim -> inspectable evidence'. The governing rule is that 'Smart Note this' means DISTILL, not STORE, executed as SYNERGIZE -> OPTIMIZE -> MAXIMIZE -> EQUALIZE -> ORGANIZE -> DISTILL, compressing until precise rather than until vague. Required perspectives: Human (preserves the original contribution and prevents the AI rewriting history), AI/Naya (synthesis, kept distinguishable from the human's words), Simple/Child (the honesty test for genuine understanding), Language/Grammar (canonical expression, not proofreading), Machine (identity, scope, authority, provenance, lineage - what makes intelligence operational), Evidence and Provenance, and Governance. Completion contract: CREATE -> PERSIST -> IDENTIFY -> PROJECT -> VERIFY -> SMART LINK -> RECEIPT, where no verified Smart Link equals no completed user-facing operation and BLOCKED_NOT_EXPLANATION is a legitimate honest outcome. The identity is allocated by the canonical receiver, never by the repository or the agent.
uncertainties: Capture could not be executed: this agent has no access to the v7-smart-note-canonical receiver (no Supabase credentials in environment, no MCP server configured, no Supabase CLI, no local receiver service on 54321/3000/8080). smart_note_transaction.execute() fails closed by design, so no Intelligent Block and no verified Smart Link exist for this proposal.

The SMART_NOTE_PROPOSAL contract defines no physical storage path for proposals and forbids a competing memory store, so the location .naya/smart-note-proposals/ is a proposal pending Director ruling, not a ratified location.

It is unconfirmed whether 'DISTILL, not STORE' is intended as a hard machine-enforced receiver precondition or as guiding prose. This proposal assumes it should be enforceable; that is a Director decision.
The threshold for which outputs require distillation is undefined, which currently makes the rule unenforceable in practice.

The related contracts governing this domain (SMART_LINK_CONTRACT, MEMBER-LEVEL-CONTRACT, and their root/schemas pairs) were found by the constitutional claim audit to be divergent and multi-defined; this proposal does not resolve that and must not be read as doing so.
evidence_status is TESTED rather than VERIFIED because the receiver has not been exercised against this proposal, so no end-to-end proof of the completion contract exists for it.

governance_evaluation.detail: The proposal is structurally valid and its provenance, privacy classification, and uncertainties are preserved. It cannot advance past VALUE_RECOGNIZED / PROPOSAL_VALIDATED because the only entity permitted to allocate an intelligent_block_id is the canonical receiver, which this agent cannot reach. Per the contract, BLOCKED is never promoted to ACCEPT_CAPTURE without new evidence or authority.
required_to_unblock: Grant this agent a scoped path to the v7-smart-note-canonical receiver (MCP tool, or SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN plus SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY as repository secrets), or
